# IMPERIA COLD WAR — shared Colonial Affairs.
# Update 22.11.2026: startup pass flags the missing ROOT for COLDWAR_COL_ui_mark_dirty.
# Generated by tools/colonial_affairs/compile.py.

on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_no_root_pass = 1 } # IMPERIA COLD WAR — 22.11.2026: no ROOT in on_startup
			# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Refresh saved same-day owner receipts once on startup.
			clear_variable = global.COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_day
			every_country = {
				limit = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_bootstrapped }
					}
					COLDWAR_COL_daily = yes
					COLDWAR_COL_select_next = yes
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_bootstrapped
				}
				else = {
					# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Share one startup world reconciliation across existing countries.
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_daily_pass = 1 }
					COLDWAR_COL_recalculate_budget = yes
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_daily_pass = 0 }
					COLDWAR_COL_refresh_view = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			COLDWAR_COL_daily = yes
		}
	}
}
